premise: A farm boy with no talent for cultivation at all, the worst in his village. One day he finds a ring with the soul of an ancient master inside.

bible.title: Echoes of the Ancient Path
bible.era: Ancient Eastern fantasy: simple farming tools, spiritual herbs, and powerful sects.

extraordinary.reach: Cultivators can manipulate elements, fly on swords, and attain immortality.
Souls of dead masters can bind to spiritual vessels, sharing knowledge and guidance.

peoples.name: Human
peoples.culture: A society organized around agrarian villages and grand cultivation sects.

creatures.name: Spiritual Wolf
creatures.description: A forest beast infused with wild qi, dangerous to mortals.

nature: Gravity is slightly weaker near high-qi spiritual veins, allowing for massive floating peaks.

rungs.name: Qi Condensation
rungs.description: Gathering qi into the meridians to strengthen the physical body.

rungs.name: Foundation Establishment
rungs.description: Purifying the gathered qi into a liquid spiritual sea.

rungs.name: Core Formation
rungs.description: Condensing the spiritual sea into a solid golden core of immense power.

rungs.name: Nascent Soul
rungs.description: Birthing a spiritual avatar within, granting true flight and massive lifespan.

rungs.name: Soul Transformation
rungs.description: Merging the mortal body with the spiritual soul, becoming a demigod.

travel.description: Most travel on foot or by horse-drawn cart. High-level cultivators fly on spiritual swords.

medicine.healing: Spiritual herbs and qi-infused pills can mend broken bones in hours.

laws.text: Cultivators must not slaughter mortals without cause.

rules.text: Qi flows through all living things and can be gathered to refine the body and soul.
A person's talent is decided by their meridians; blocked meridians cannot normally absorb qi.
An ancient soul bound to an object cannot cross over to the afterlife until the object is destroyed.

mysteries.question: Who was the master trapped inside the ring?
mysteries.answer: Master Mo was once the Grand Elder of a rival sect that was destroyed by Jade Peak's founders.
clues: An inscription on the inside of the ring matching an ancient, forbidden sect crest.
Master Mo's extreme hostility whenever the Jade Peak Sect's founding ancestors are mentioned.

player.name: Xiao Chen
player.description: A scruffy, hardworking farm boy with calloused hands and a stubborn glint in his eyes.
player.appearance: Messy black hair tied with a simple hemp string, a wiry build from years of farm work, wearing a patched grey cotton tunic.

skills.name: Farming
skills.notes: Excellent at weeding, planting, and predicting the weather.

skills.name: Endurance
skills.notes: Accustomed to working long hours under the hot sun.

traits.name: Blocked Meridians
traits.description: Your pathways for qi are completely clogged, making standard cultivation exercises useless.

traits.name: Unyielding Will
traits.description: The harder things get, the more stubborn you become. Mental attacks struggle to shake you.

talents.name: Cultivation Talent
talents.covers: Gathering and refining ambient qi through standard breathing methods.

temperament.voice: Polite but firm, with a slightly rough rustic accent.

items.name: Ancient Ring
items.description: A heavy, tarnished bronze ring carved with foreign spiritual runes. It feels warm to the touch.

items.name: Rusty Hoe
items.description: A well-worn farming implement with a chipped wooden shaft.

master-mo.name: Master Mo
master-mo.description: A wispy, floating spirit with a critical eye, sharp wit, and centuries of lost knowledge.
master-mo.appearance: A translucent old man wearing flowing robes of a bygone era, with long silver hair and beard.

wants: to find a worthy successor and rebuild his physical body
temperament.voice: A dry, echoing whisper that speaks directly into your mind.

agenda.goal: Test the player character's resolve and teach them unorthodox cultivation paths.
agenda.method: Using spiritual resonance from the ring to guide the player's internal energy.

secrets: He was betrayed by his own disciples, which is how his soul became sealed in the ring.

li-wei.name: Li Wei
li-wei.description: The arrogant son of the village chief, widely considered the most talented youth in Greenwood.
li-wei.appearance: A tall, broad-shouldered youth wearing fine silk robes that are too expensive for a farmer.

wants: to join the Jade Peak Sect and leave this village behind

jade-peak-sect.name: Jade Peak Sect
jade-peak-sect.description: The dominant cultivation sect of the Azure Hills, recruiting talented youths.

greenwood-council.name: Greenwood Elder Council
greenwood-council.description: The group of village elders who handle farming disputes and yearly taxes.

azure-hills.name: Azure Hills
azure-hills.description: A picturesque, mist-shrouded region of rolling green hills and deep forests.

greenwood-village.name: Greenwood Village
greenwood-village.description: A small, quiet farming village nestled at the foot of the mountains.

greenwood-fields.name: Greenwood Fields
greenwood-fields.description: The terraced rice and barley fields where the villagers labor daily.

mountain-cave.name: Damp Cave
mountain-cave.description: A cool, dark cave hidden behind thick briars at the edge of the fields.

jade-peak-sect.name: Jade Peak Sect
jade-peak-sect.description: A towering sect built upon steep mountain peaks, home to proud cultivators.

fact-1.text: You have blocked meridians, which makes you unable to cultivate qi through normal breathing exercises.

fact-2.text: The village bullies, led by Li Wei, mock you constantly for being the worst in Greenwood.

fact-3.text: The Jade Peak Sect is holding its recruitment trial in three days.

awaken-master.title: The Master's Guidance
awaken-master.stakes: Gaining the ancient master's trust and learning his lost techniques.

sect-trials.title: Jade Peak Sect Trials
sect-trials.stakes: Escaping village life and gaining access to real cultivation resources.

sect-recruitment.name: Sect Recruitment
steps: The Jade Peak Sect heralds arrive in Greenwood.
The youth of the village line up to have their spiritual roots tested.
The chosen disciples depart, leaving the rest behind.

event-1.title: Sect Recruitment: The Jade Peak Sect heralds arrive in Greenwood.

positions: You are kneeling on the damp cave floor.
Master Mo's spirit is floating three feet above the bronze ring.
scene.ended_on: The silver spirit of Master Mo hovers in the warm light of the ring, waiting for your answer.

state.summary: A farm boy with no talent for cultivation finds an ancient ring in a hidden cave. Inside the ring lies the soul of a powerful master from a bygone era, offering a path to power.

scenes.narration:
In the cold, damp gloom of the mountain cave, you crouch among the wet stones. Your fingers brush a heavy, tarnished bronze ring half-buried in the dirt. At your touch, the ancient metal thrums, and a soft, golden light spills from its runic carvings, washing over the dark cavern walls. The air grows warm and heavy with wild qi, humming against your blocked meridians like a distant drum.

From the ring, a mist of silver spiritual light rises, swirling into the translucent form of an old man. His long silver beard and ancient robes float as if underwater. Master Mo looks down at you with a sharp, critical eye that seems to pierce straight through your soul.

"A mortal boy with completely ruined pathways," a dry, echoing voice whispers directly inside your mind, sounding deeply unimpressed. "To think my long slumber would be broken by one who cannot even draw a single breath of qi. Tell me, boy, why should I not return to my sleep and leave you to rot in this dirt?"

choices: Speak with polite determination, explaining your desire to become strong.
Ask the spirit what kind of unorthodox methods could clear your meridians.
Demand to know who he is before you give him any answers.
